Exact historical NumPy version was not recorded. Arithmetic selection materially changes validation results and requires the user's choice; this PR selects none. See implementation/reports/gsup_v2_oracle/ARITHMETIC_REDUCTION_REVIEW_2026-10-03.md.

Trusted synthetic authority configuration is external to untrusted attempt specs; privileged authority replacement/deletion is outside the protocol threat model.
